idea: How to maintain a home water system
title: Keep Your Home Water Running Smoothly: Essential Maintenance Tips
description: Maintaining your home water system doesn't have to be overwhelming. Simple, consistent habits can prevent costly leaks and water pressure issues down the road. Start by regularly checking visible pipes under sinks for moisture or corrosion. Drain a few gallons from your water heater tank annually to remove sediment build-up and improve efficiency. Always locate and test your main water shut-off valve so you can act quickly during an emergency. Finally, monitor your monthly water bill for sudden increases, which often signal hidden leaks. For complex system checks or backflow prevention, scheduling a yearly professional inspection ensures your plumbing stays safe and reliable.
